description:
## Problem

None of `app.models.{save,enableAll,clearAll,toggleProvider,reorderUp,reorderDown}` are implemented. The selector is activated by typing `/scoped-models` (no default key).

## Upstream component

`tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/components/scoped-models-selector.ts`. Handler at lines 234-349. Opened via `/scoped-models` (`interactive-mode.ts:2412-2415`):

```ts
if (text === "/scoped-models") {
  this.editor.setText("");
  await this.showModelsSelector();
  return;
}
```

## Bindings consumed (`scoped-models-selector.ts:234-349`)

| Action | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `tui.select.up` / `down` | up/down | `:238-249` Wrap navigation |
| `app.models.reorderUp` | `alt+up` | `:252-271` Move enabled model earlier; only if current is enabled and within bounds |
| `app.models.reorderDown` | `alt+down` | Same direction down |
| `tui.select.confirm` | enter | `:274-283` Toggle enable/disable for current item |
| `app.models.enableAll` | `ctrl+a` | `:286-293` Enable all (or filtered subset if search active) |
| `app.models.clearAll` | `ctrl+x` | `:296-303` Clear all (or filtered subset if search active) |
| `app.models.toggleProvider` | `ctrl+p` | `:306-320` Toggle all models for current row's provider |
| `app.models.save` | `ctrl+s` | `:323-328` `callbacks.onPersist(enabledIds)` — write to settings |
| `ctrl+c` | — | `:331-339` Clear search if non-empty, else cancel |
| `escape` | — | `:342-345` Cancel |
| (anything else) | — | `:348` Forward to search input |

## Helper functions used

`enableAll`, `clearAll`, `toggle`, `move`, `isEnabled` — likely in same file or imported. Reorder uses index-based move with delta ±1 (`:258-265`).

## Footer hint text (`scoped-models-selector.ts:131, 170-174`)

- "Session-only. {ctrl+s} to save to settings."
- "{ctrl+a} all  {ctrl+x} clear  {ctrl+p} provider  {alt+up}/{alt+down} reorder  {ctrl+s} save"

## Required defaults to add to `OctoPi.TUI.Keybindings`

```elixir
"app.models.save" => %{keys: ["ctrl+s"], description: "Save model selection"},
"app.models.enableAll" => %{keys: ["ctrl+a"], description: "Enable all models"},
"app.models.clearAll" => %{keys: ["ctrl+x"], description: "Clear all models"},
"app.models.toggleProvider" => %{keys: ["ctrl+p"], description: "Toggle all models for provider"},
"app.models.reorderUp" => %{keys: ["alt+up"], description: "Move model up in order"},
"app.models.reorderDown" => %{keys: ["alt+down"], description: "Move model down in order"},
```

## Persistence

`onPersist(enabledIds | null)` callback — interactive-mode wires this to settings storage. `enabledIds === null` means "no scoped subset, use full registry". The Elixir equivalent should write to whatever settings persistence exists (look for `SettingsManager` analog).

## Files likely created/modified

- New: `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/scoped_models_selector.ex`.
- Update: `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/keybindings.ex`.
- Update: `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex` — `/scoped-models` slash command + `show_models_selector` modal mount.
- Persistence: find via `grep -r ScopedModels apps/`.

## Acceptance

- `/scoped-models` opens the selector listing all configured models.
- Enter toggles enable/disable.
- `ctrl+a` / `ctrl+x` enable/clear (filtered subset if search active).
- `ctrl+p` toggles all for current provider.
- `alt+up` / `alt+down` reorder enabled subset.
- `ctrl+s` persists to settings.
- Escape / `ctrl+c` (with empty search) cancels.
